rows.en: Starting the Checkpoint tutorial.
Examining a checkpoint fully heals the party and lets you save.
Once you examine a checkpoint, you can warp to it from base.
Choosing "Return" in the Camp Menu takes you back to base anytime, with a full heal.
Starting the Ride Dungeon tutorial.
A Ride Dungeon is a special dungeon you explore aboard a Ride Machine.
Giant enemies called "Guardians" roam here. Touching one starts a Ride Battle.
Some Guardians will chase you once they spot your Ride Machine.
A warning appears on screen when an enemy spots you. Move with caution when it does.
Some walls in Ride Dungeons can be smashed by your Ride Machine's drill, but
each has a level, and it can't be broken without a drill of that level or higher.
Breaking a wall releases dense energy that restores HP and EN.
Starting the Ride Battle tutorial.
In Ride Battles, the Heroes pilot Ride Machines to fight Guardians.
Attacks: Main Cannon (Ranged) and Drill (Physical). The cannon must be charged first, so
after choosing Charge in the Main Cannon commands, you need to choose Fire.
You can charge the Main Cannon up to 4 times. The more charges, the stronger the shot.
The Drill is used with the Gun Turret command.
Once equipped, the Drill works while moving and in battle, where it damages enemies.
Unlike the Main Cannon, though, it uses a lot of EN (energy), so be careful.
EN powers every action except Fire and Strafe. It's like SP in normal battles.
EN is restored by landing attacks such as Strafe during a Ride Battle.
Ride Machines carry a device that restores armor (HP).
Using it restores armor, but it costs EN in exchange.
Sorry for the long explanation. But I'll keep going.
Barrage, a Gun Turret command, uses a lot of EN but can cancel an enemy's action.
If an enemy looks like it's about to use a powerful attack, don't hesitate to try Barrage.
Lastly, Support Units. A Ride Machine can equip up to 3 Support Units.
They use EN and give you an edge in Ride Battles.
Starting the Equipment Upgrade tutorial.
At the Item Lab, you can upgrade equipment by fusing it with other equipment or materials.
To fuse, first choose the equipment you want to upgrade,
then choose the equipment or materials to fuse into it.
The upgraded stats are shown on the right side of the screen.
Each piece of equipment can be fused up to 5 times, so choose carefully.
Starting the Idle Action tutorial.
You can give orders to Heroes you didn't pick for the party while they stand by.
To set Idle Actions, use the Idle Action command in the Briefing Room.
Each time the party fights a battle, the other Heroes carry out their Idle Actions and gain EXP.
Now let's go over what each Idle Action does.
"Training Facility Boost": leveling it up increases the EXP gained while idle.
Idle members will receive a bigger share.
"Security Duty": leveling it up increases the Material you earn.
Leveling up increases the amount of Material you obtain.
"Material Gathering": leveling it up lets you gather better materials.
Leveling up lets you obtain better materials.
That's all for the Idle Action tutorial.
Gathered materials are sent to storage automatically. Any that don't fit are sold.
Starting the Random Cube tutorial.
A Random Cube is a special dungeon whose layout changes every time you enter.
Defeat the boss in the deepest part to clear it and claim the chest behind it as your reward.
Generally, the more you clear, the harder it gets, and harder Cubes drop better items.
You can check the current Random Cube's details in the Dungeon Parameters.
Starting the Item Search tutorial.
Item Search is now available in Ride Dungeons.
Item Search is always shown on the Ride Dungeon screen and reacts as you near hidden treasure.
It changes as shown in the diagram the closer you get, so examine any spot that feels right!
If treasure is hidden where you examined, you'll get the item.
Valuable items are hidden away, so search actively!
Starting the Casino tutorial.
At the Casino, you can buy casino-only coins and use them to play minigames.
Winning minigames earns more coins, which you can trade for prizes.
Raise the Casino upgrade level in Idle Actions to unlock more minigames and prizes.
Starting the Status tutorial.
Let's go over what each Hero stat means.
Physical ATK affects the power of physical attacks like punches and kicks.
Physical DEF affects defense against enemy physical attacks.
Ranged ATK affects the power of ranged attacks like rifles and beams.
Ranged DEF affects defense against enemy ranged attacks.
Slash attack power and defense depend on the average of Physical and Ranged.
Strength affects the power of Physical and Slash attacks.
Spirit affects the power and defense of Physical and Slash attacks.
Speed affects how fast you act in battle.
Luck affects critical rate and escape chance.
Technique affects the power of Ranged and Slash attacks.
Focus affects critical rate, plus the power and defense of Ranged and Slash attacks.
Mind affects resistance to status ailments.
Skills are whatever.
General
Barabas targets Heroes with high HP.
